mapping_diagnosis.distinguishing_reason: The story excellently demonstrates the relativity of motion/rest (n3) through the same exam paper receiving opposite judgments from different examiners. Node n2 (mechanical motion as mental/writing process) is mapped but less explicitly tied to the physical concept of position change over time. Edge e2 (reference object enables relativity) is implied but not directly stated as a causal enablement; the story shows the reference object (standard answer) being used for judgment, but the enabling relation is more implicit than explicit.

revision_instructions: To strengthen edge e2, consider adding a sentence explicitly stating that the standard answer (reference object) enables the judgment of the exam paper's quality (relativity). For example: '正是因为有这个标准答案作为参照，考官才能判断考卷的优劣。'
For node n2, you could add a brief phrase linking the writing process to the concept of mechanical motion, e.g., '考生的思维和书写过程，如同物体的位置随时间变化，是一种机械运动。'
